blocks.prompt: 6 Find \(n\) so that \(\frac{a^{n+1} + b^{n+1}}{a^{n} + b^{n}}\) may be H.M. between \(a\) and \(b\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh sawal thora mushkil lagta hai kyunke unknown \(n\) power mein hai. Lekin idea seedha hai: di gayi fraction ko \(a\) aur \(b\) ke H.M. \(\frac{2ab}{a + b}\) ke barabar hona chahiye.
Plan: dono ko barabar likho, cross-multiply karo, sab ek taraf la kar factor karo, aur \(a \ne b\) ka faida uthao.
Is mein laws of indices (powers ke qawaneen) bahut kaam aayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{a^{n+1} + b^{n+1}}{a^{n} + b^{n}}\) ko \(a\) aur \(b\) ka H.M. hona hai (\(a \ne b\)).
Humein find karna hai: \(n\).
Tareeqa: H.M. ka formula \(H = \frac{2ab}{a + b}\). Fraction ko is ke barabar rakh kar simplify karte jayenge jab tak \(n\) saaf nazar na aa jaye.

Equation banayein
\[\dfrac{a^{n+1} + b^{n+1}}{a^{n} + b^{n}} = \dfrac{2ab}{a + b}\]
Kyun: "H.M. ho" ka matlab hai H.M. ke formula ke barabar ho.

Cross-multiply karein
\[(a^{n+1} + b^{n+1})(a + b)\]
\[= 2ab(a^{n} + b^{n})\]
Kyun: Dono taraf ke denominators hatane ke liye. Fractions ke saath kaam karna mushkil hota hai, seedhi lines aasaan.

Dono taraf kholein
\[a^{n+2} + a^{n+1}b + ab^{n+1} + b^{n+2}\]
\[= 2a^{n+1}b + 2ab^{n+1}\]
Kyun: Laws of indices: same base ki powers multiply hon to powers jurti hain, \(a^{n+1} \cdot a = a^{n+2}\). Right side par \(2ab \cdot a^{n} = 2a^{n+1}b\), kyunke \(a \cdot a^{n} = a^{n+1}\).
Dhyan dein: \(a^{n+1} \cdot b\) ko \(ab^{n+1}\) na samjhein; power sirf apne base ki hoti hai.

Sab ek taraf layein
\[a^{n+2} - a^{n+1}b - ab^{n+1} + b^{n+2} = 0\]
Kyun: Right side ko left se minus kiya: \(a^{n+1}b - 2a^{n+1}b = -a^{n+1}b\), aur isi tarah \(ab^{n+1} - 2ab^{n+1} = -ab^{n+1}\).

Grouping se factor karein
\[a^{n+1}(a - b) - b^{n+1}(a - b) = 0\]
\[(a - b)(a^{n+1} - b^{n+1}) = 0\]
Kyun: Pehli do terms se \(a^{n+1}\) common nikala to \((a - b)\) bacha; aakhri do se \(-b^{n+1}\) common nikala to phir \((a - b)\). Ab \((a - b)\) dono mein common hai.

\(a \ne b\) istemal karein
\[a^{n+1} - b^{n+1} = 0\]
\[\left(\dfrac{a}{b}\right)^{n+1} = 1 = \left(\dfrac{a}{b}\right)^{0}\]
\[n + 1 = 0 \Rightarrow n = -1\]
Kyun: Do cheezon ka product zero ho to koi ek zero hoti hai. \(a - b\) zero nahi (numbers alag hain), to doosra factor zero hai. \(b^{n+1}\) se divide kiya to \(\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^{n+1} = 1\). Jo number 1 nahi, us ki power 1 sirf tab banti hai jab power zero ho.

Tasdeeq
\[n = -1: \; \dfrac{a^{0} + b^{0}}{a^{-1} + b^{-1}} = \dfrac{2}{\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}}\]
\[= \dfrac{2}{\frac{a + b}{ab}} = \dfrac{2ab}{a + b} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(a^{0} = b^{0} = 1\) aur \(a^{-1} = \frac{1}{a}\). Fraction bilkul H.M. ban gayi. Answer key bhi \(-1\) deti hai.
Yaad rakhein: isi tarah \(n = 0\) se A.M. \(\frac{a + b}{2}\) aur \(n = -\frac{1}{2}\) se G.M. \(\sqrt{ab}\) milta hai.
